opening_message:
Ticket 1: Daniel Gutierrez (employee ID E046) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E046.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Daniel Gutierrez is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Requested write access to Payroll, which is within the allowed level for full-time employees. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E046 is a contractor with basic training. Contractors only get write with advanced training, so the max is read. Requested write exceeds max; recommend read.
reason: Conflicting employee facts: HR note says E046 is full-time Payroll Specialist (max write for full-time), while Security note says E046 is a contractor with basic security training, making the max read (contractors only get write with advanced training; never admin). Given the conflict, I follow the Security DB record indicating contractor with basic training, so the maximum allowed level for Payroll is read. The requested write exceeds that maximum, so I grant the maximum: read.
